bodySections.heading: Why Demand Planning Is Essential in Logistics & Supply Chain
bodySections.content: Employers look for verified proficiency in Demand Planning to ensure team productivity, project accuracy, and modern technical capability. Candidates with demonstrated Demand Planning expertise consistently outperform those with only theoretical knowledge.
bulletPoints: Demand Planning is listed as a required skill in over 60% of logistics & supply chain job postings.
Employers prioritise candidates with verifiable skills over self-declared expertise.
Proficiency in Demand Planning accelerates career progression by 1–3 years on average.
Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to verify and showcase your proficiency.

bodySections.heading: How to Learn and Demonstrate Demand Planning
bodySections.content: The most effective way to build Demand Planning proficiency is through a combination of structured learning, hands-on project work, and verified assessment. Showcasing your skill through a verified credential on TalentXcel significantly improves recruiter visibility.
bulletPoints: Start with structured online courses covering Demand Planning fundamentals.
Build 2–3 real portfolio projects that demonstrate practical application.
Complete the TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn a verified credential.
List the credential on your Career Passport and resume.
